page_title: GEN 1-0 VER | Genoa v Verona 10/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' Davide Faraoni (Verona) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Riccardo Saponara (Verona) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
86' The substitution has been made. Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) has replaced Kevin Strootman.
86' Ondrej Duda (Verona) sees a yellow card from Daniele Orsato after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
86' Substitution. Michael Folorunsho is replaced by Riccardo Saponara (Verona).
86' Alberto Gilardino has decided to substitute Milan Badelj and he is replaced by Morten Thorsby (Genoa).
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ridgeciano Haps leaves the pitch and Alan Matturro (Genoa) comes on.
85' Kevin Strootman (Genoa) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
83' Davide Faraoni (Verona) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
81' Davide Faraoni (Verona) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

79' Milan Djuric (Verona) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Verona are going to take it.
79' Ondrej Duda (Verona) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
78' Ondrej Duda (Verona) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

74' Filippo Terracciano (Verona) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the middle of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ondrej Duda (Verona) comes onto the pitch so that Bruno Amione can be given a rest.
70' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) prepares to take a corner kick.
66' The foul by Davide Faraoni (Verona) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Daniele Orsato.
63' Marco Baroni prepares a substitution. Tomas Suslov is replaced by Juan Manuel Cruz (Verona).
63' Here comes a substitution. Davide Faraoni (Verona) is brought on as a substitute for Josh Doig.
63' Great save! Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the roof of the net was brilliantly saved by Lorenzo Montipo.
61' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) takes the corner.
60' Filippo Terracciano (Verona) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Daniele Orsato didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

58' George Puscas (Genoa) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the crossbar. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Lorenzo Montipo with a fabulous save.
58' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

58' George Puscas (Genoa) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
54' Substitution. George Puscas (Genoa) replaces Caleb Ekuban.
53' The corner from Filippo Terracciano (Verona) is cleared away by the defence.

52' Tomas Suslov (Verona) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Daniele Orsato with no other option than to blow for a foul. Genoa are awarded a free kick.
50' Ridgeciano Haps (Genoa) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
49' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Daniele Orsato ignores the protests.
47' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Marco Baroni gives a chance to Cyril Ngonge (Verona) and Federico Bonazzoli is off.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Milan Badelj (Genoa) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
45+2' Josep Martinez comes off his line to intercept the corner from Tomas Suslov (Verona).
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' 1 - 0 Radu Dragusin (Genoa) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets inside the right post.

43' Koni De Winter (Genoa) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the middle of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
43' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) receives a decent pass inside the box and curls in an effort on goal, but the ball hits the outside of the right post and flies out of play.
43' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) is about to take a corner kick.
42' The free kick is taken by Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa), but ball is cleared. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Genoa.
42' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Genoa are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
41' Mattia Bani (Genoa) is substituted due to injury. Alberto Gilardino gives a chance to Koni De Winter.
38' Bruno Amione (Verona) sends a cross into the box, but Josep Martinez comes off his line to gather the ball.
37' Josh Doig (Verona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
37' Josh Doig (Verona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

35' The game is interrupted. Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Verona are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
33' Kevin Strootman (Genoa) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Daniele Orsato has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Verona are awarded the free kick.
33' Bruno Amione (Verona) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
32' Filippo Terracciano (Verona) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
31' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) makes a strong challenge and Daniele Orsato blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Genoa, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
29' Filippo Terracciano (Verona) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
26' Isak Hien (Verona) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
25' The corner from Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) is intercepted by the defence.
22' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.

18' Tomas Suslov (Verona) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Daniele Orsato blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Genoa have been awarded a free kick.
17' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) tackles a bit over-zealously and Daniele Orsato blows for a foul. Verona get a free kick.
16' Milan Djuric (Verona) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
15' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) commits a rough challenge and Daniele Orsato blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Verona will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
14' Filippo Terracciano (Verona) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Genoa have a free kick.
9' The free kick is delivered by Milan Djuric (Verona) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
8' Isak Hien (Verona) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Daniele Orsato blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Genoa in a dangerous position.
6' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) fails to produce a decent enough free kick for a player of his ability and the only target that he finds is the wall of defenders in front of him.

6' Tomas Suslov (Verona) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Genoa win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
3' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
1' Tomas Suslov (Verona) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Daniele Orsato blows for a foul. Genoa have a free kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Genoa will have the kick-off.
Daniele Orsato got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
